title: Core Platform Rules
content: Initial core rules for the TYT Platform v2. These define how we structure code, name things, document, and automate.

items.title: Language & Comments
items.why: Consistency and accessibility for mixed audiences.
items.what: Code in English; comments in Vietnamese.
items.how: Functions, variables, modules use clear English names; add VN comments for intent and constraints.

items.title: Folder Structure
items.what: Root contains: entity/, projects/, scripts/, logs/, tmp/, Makefile.
items.how: Shared code in entity/; project-specific in projects/<name>/www; automation in scripts/; history in logs/.

items.title: Naming (Generic & Reusable)
items.what: Function/class names must be generic (no project-specific terms) within entity/.
items.how: Prefer dataLoader, renderer, screen, etc.; avoid biggerdot-specific names in entity/.

items.title: JavaScript Standard
items.how: Avoid modern syntax that breaks older environments; transpile later if needed.

items.title: Platform Loader Pattern
items.what: Use tyt.define/tyt.require/tyt.exec/tyt.router with shared libs in entity/.
items.how: Projects define tyt.srcConfig in define.js; loader sets directories and executes lib/index().

items.title: Documentation Data
items.how: Each item: {id, version, category, title, content, tags[], links[]}; follow schema.json.

items.title: Automation & History
items.what: Use Makefile tasks; log actions to logs/history.jsonl.
items.how: make serve/stop/status/open-doc auto-log; use make history-add for manual entries.

items.title: No External Frameworks
items.what: Pure HTML/CSS/JS in projects; small utilities in entity/.
items.how: Avoid React/Vue/etc.; keep DOM and CSS minimal.

items.title: Versioning
items.what: Use git tags for releases; maintain HISTORY via logs/history.jsonl.
items.how: Tag doc-site/content versions (e.g., v2.0.0); record changes with make history-add.
